items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: And then I did "Drowning in My Own Tears" with Ray Charles.

ctx.x: Yeah, it was a long time since I'd seen him. Man, what a list.

And then I did "What a Difference a Day Makes" with Dinah Washington. Now that was another one that everyone was talking about the rhythm, and the rhythm on that was the press rolls with the brushes -- that was what that was. Instead of playing like that with the sticks, I played with the brushes. (Demonstrates) And that sold; that was a big hit. And then I did "Drowning in My Own Tears" with Ray Charles. Now that was quite an experience for me, because Ray was the one who pulled my coat how to taught me to play…
And all I played, I'm telling you ...
